doc.title: Ralph Humphrey interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003

title: His parents' support
summary: Humphrey says his parents have always supported what he does.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Right. So do you think your father was surprised at your success?

I don’t know. I never asked him. He never told me. I don’t think my mother is surprised, and probably my father isn’t either. You know what I mean? He supports everything I do. They’ve always supported everything I do, and I’m thankful for that. They didn’t try to steer me some other way.
